location.story: How The Monkey Saved His Troop

approved_translation: Quick thinking and courage can save many; a leader acts for the good of all.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: A mango-tree grew on the bank of a great river. The fruit fell from some of the branches of this tree into the river, and from other branches it fell on the ground. "That big Monkey," said the king to the archers, "saved the whole troop. I will see to it that he is taken care of the rest of his life."
